title: 5-toubun no Princess: Gensou to Shinen to Mahou Gakuin
content:
That was the least expected kind of spin-off you could imagine. But hell yeah.

Not gonna lie, my Black Clover nostalgia kicked-in, with a twist of Sword Art Online while watching this. Although, I do not see how the quintuplet dynamic contributed to any of that.

The only thing new here is a slight character design and a cool furry monster to play off the Harry Potter fantasy off of. Honestly, the franchises has been miss after miss ever since the Movie. They can just call it quits and save face.

Odd that their step dad has been getting so much screen time recently.
Overall: 6.1/10.
